description: Implement a 'Save as Template' feature that allows users to convert any existing document into a reusable template. This feature should be accessible from multiple entry points in the document management interface and should preserve the document's content and structure while creating a new template envelope.
functional_requirements: Add a 'Save as Template' option to the document action dropdown in the documents table
Include a 'Save as Template' option in the document page view dropdown menu
Implement a dialog interface for confirming template creation with appropriate naming and description fields
Create backend functionality to duplicate any document (regardless of current status) into a new template envelope
Ensure the feature works within the envelope editor interface for active document editing
Add proper validation and error handling for template creation operations
